name: iamf
character: An IAMF (AOMedia Immersive Audio Model and Formats) deliverable: the engine builds its ADM BW64 file and hands it to the external AOMedia iamf-tools encoder, which writes the .iamf stream. The encoder is not vendored: build iamf-tools and point IAMF_ENCODER at its encoder_main, or put it on PATH. Selecting this target without the encoder is an error that names that fix, never a silent fallback. The file is checked structurally here; it is not decoded with libiamf or profile-validated.
label: IAMF (external iamf-tools encoder)
sources: AOMedia, Immersive Audio Model and Formats (IAMF) v2.0.0, approved as an AOM Final Deliverable on 2026-08-24
AOMedia iamf-tools, encoder_main: the ADM BWF input path (--adm_filename), which the tool documents as experimental for some conversions; the WAV + textproto path is the controlled one
The engine writes the ADM file itself (BS.2076-3 / BS.2088-2), then calls the external encoder; the .iamf file is not decoded or profile-validated by this project
